response.sql: WITH matched_pairs AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.recordvault, o.timespan FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault), bucket_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(timespan, 'NO_TIMESPAN') AS timespan_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS bucket_count FROM matched_pairs GROUP BY COALESCE(timespan, 'NO_TIMESPAN')), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(bucket_count) AS total_orders FROM bucket_counts), bucket_shares AS (SELECT bc.bucket_count, CAST(bc.bucket_count AS FLOAT) / ts.total_orders AS bucket_share FROM bucket_counts bc CROSS JOIN total_sum ts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(bucket_share) AS avg_share FROM bucket_shares), filtered_buckets AS (SELECT bs.bucket_count, bs.bucket_share, bs.bucket_share - ashr.avg_share AS excess FROM bucket_shares bs CROSS JOIN average_share ashr WHERE bs.bucket_share > ashr.avg_share) SELECT SUM(bucket_count) AS total_count_kept, AVG(bucket_share) AS average_share_kept, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM filtered_buckets
